claims: CeCe Boozer is Cindy "CeCe" Nichole Blackwell.
CeCe Boozer is the mother of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are Duke basketball twins.
CeCe Boozer is the ex-wife of Carlos Boozer.
Carlos Boozer is a former NBA star.
CeCe Boozer is a former college athlete.
CeCe Boozer's eldest son has sickle cell anemia.
CeCe Boozer's advocacy in finding a medical cure for her eldest son's sickle cell anemia led to the birth of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
